scripts.start: pnpm predev && concurrently -k --kill-signal SIGKILL -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "pnpm --filter backend dev" "pnpm --filter frontend dev"
scripts.predev: lsof -i tcp:5174 -t 2>/dev/null | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || true; lsof -i tcp:5173 -t 2>/dev/null | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || true
